claim: Formal CRNs can be systematically compiled into DNA strand-displacement systems approximating target kinetics.
Experimental seesaw circuits included a four-bit square-root circuit comprising 130 DNA strands.
DNA strand-displacement cascades implemented a neural-network/associative-memory-style computation.
Serum-supplemented media require degradation-aware characterization and can alter circuit behavior.
Direct D-DNA/L-DNA comparison in living mammalian cells found environmental stability/kinetic differences.
